evidence.diagnosis: Firefox/WebKit default img.loading IDL reports eager for missing/invalid loading attribute. The implementation confused this with explicit author eager and skipped lazy initialization. All eight enabled-profile Firefox/WebKit JS cases failed on missing plain img loading=lazy. This is a real product defect; no collector reclassification. The new 9a0f920 candidate fixes content-attribute detection; its separate 24/24 Halo run is recorded as native-images-fixed-candidate. This original failure remains unchanged.
limitations: Headless browser checks; not physical phones, actual Safari, screen reader or full fixed-Hexo parity.
Native lazy loading may fetch near-viewport images before entry; there is no zero-request-before-viewport assertion.
Ordinary author img without a loading attribute is recorded separately; post-parse JS lazy does not prove initial request deferral.
Broken authored images without an explicit fallback retain their URL and readable alt; no replacement is promised.
Headless Playwright Chromium/Firefox/WebKit; no physical device or Safari-app claim.
Configuration is applied before each phase; PJAX/back/forward reentry is exercised within each phase.
Missing-plugin and old-plugin states require separate evidence; disabled is not absent.
notes: Independent new run after collector timing/default-locale/no-JS setup fixes. The first incomplete run is preserved separately. Source/package is d61/fb27; this does not claim later image-loading candidate was tested by this batch.
